theme.vibe: Sunny sidewalk ride with gentle safety cues

pages.text: This is a bicycle. It has two wheels. It has a seat. A rider makes it go.
extras: One wheel in front. One wheel in back.

images.alt: A helmeted child riding a small bicycle with training wheels.

pages.text: The wheels roll. The tires touch the path. Roll, roll, roll.

images.alt: A close-up of a bicycle wheel, tire, and spokes.

pages.text: Feet push the pedals. Around and around. The bike moves forward.

images.alt: A close-up of a bicycle pedal for a rider's foot.

pages.text: Hands hold the handlebars. Turn a little. The front wheel turns too.

images.alt: Bicycle handlebars used to steer the front wheel.

pages.text: Some little bikes have no pedals. Feet push, push. The rider learns to balance.

images.alt: A young child using a balance bike on a marked cycle path.

pages.text: Helmet on. Strap snug. Shoes on. Ready to ride.
extras: A helmet is for every ride.

images.alt: A grown-up gently buckling a young child's colorful bicycle helmet strap.

pages.text: Slow down. Stop. Look both ways with a grown-up. Then go again.

images.alt: Children practicing bike handling skills near cones at a safety event.

pages.text: Ride on the path. Give walkers room. Ding, ding! A bell can say, 'I am coming by.'

images.alt: A helmeted young child riding slowly on a wide park path while a walker gives space nearby.
A sign showing a path for bicycles and people walking.
